profile.name: Desirée Barreto
bio: My creativity thrives where cultural pulse encounters systems design. Based in Dubai, I am a human-centred designer, strategist, and design educator, skilled at design systems, brand and CX strategy and go-to-market activation.
My experience spans strategic synthesis across categories (tech, ed, QSR, FMCG, hospitality, cultural institutions), operationalising strategy at scale, and leading cross-functional teams.

experiences.title: Creative Strategist & Operations Lead
experiences.description: Architected multi-channel launch strategies and bespoke operational systems, delivering a 45.6% sustained social growth rate and cutting content delivery times by 30%. Managed multi-departmental operations and premier cultural venue partnerships, achieving a 4.8/5 satisfaction rating across all cohorts.

experiences.title: Assembly & Press and Comms - Youth Takeover 2025
experiences.description: Spearheaded press and content strategies that garnered 100K+ organic Instagram engagements and secured features in GQ Middle East, Dazed MENA, and Hypebeast Arabia. Co-curated a month-long exhibition attracting 1,000+ visitors — the most successful Youth Takeover in the Centre's history.

experiences.title: Jr. UX Executive Intern
experiences.description: Audited high-traffic digital touchpoints and optimised user journeys for government and hospitality accounts. Presented Gen Z-driven strategic frameworks at the company town hall, earning direct commendation from the Group CEO.

experiences.title: Strategy & Insights Intern
experiences.description: Delivered data-backed strategic briefs for market-leading clients including McDonald's, Samsung, and Jeep, contributing to Effie-recognised campaigns. Led an EMEA intern cohort of 15 across four markets, deploying a unified strategic framework that streamlined cross-border collaboration.

experiences.title: Editorial Intern
experiences.description: Authored cultural features for print and web platforms reaching 60,000+ monthly unique visitors. Produced targeted digital content strategies that sustained a steady 4% organic growth rate across social media channels.
